title: Company and issue activity history
summary: Attributed retained history, scoped access, date/resource filters and non-executing change display. Issue detail can consume the same history service. Related tests are references only.

cases.title: Read company activity
preconditions: Company-wide history requires a company administrator; exact issue history cases use a currently authorized project reader.
steps: Open Company activity as administrator.
expected: Attributed company events show action, resource context and current readable labels.

cases.title: Read web channel attribution
preconditions: Company-wide history requires a company administrator; exact issue history cases use a currently authorized project reader.
steps: Inspect a mutation initiated through the web app.
expected: The event displays Web channel with its human actor.

cases.title: Read MCP channel attribution
preconditions: Company-wide history requires a company administrator; exact issue history cases use a currently authorized project reader.
steps: Inspect a mutation initiated through MCP.
expected: The event displays MCP channel with the acting human account.

cases.title: Identify automated reminder
preconditions: Company-wide history requires a company administrator; exact issue history cases use a currently authorized project reader.
steps: Inspect scheduled due-reminder activity.
expected: The page labels it Automated reminder rather than implying a human click.

cases.title: Search complete issue key live
preconditions: Company-wide history requires a company administrator; exact issue history cases use a currently authorized project reader.
steps: Type a complete issue key into the history filter.
expected: Matching history loads without clicking a search button.

cases.title: Reject incomplete issue key
preconditions: Company-wide history requires a company administrator; exact issue history cases use a currently authorized project reader.
steps: Enter a key not matching the complete project-number format.
expected: Validation explains a complete issue key is required.

cases.title: Filter by project
preconditions: Company-wide history requires a company administrator; exact issue history cases use a currently authorized project reader.
steps: Select a project.
expected: Only that project matching events remain.

cases.title: Page activity project choices
preconditions: Company-wide history requires a company administrator; exact issue history cases use a currently authorized project reader.
steps: Choose Load more projects in the filter panel.
expected: Further accessible project options load without replacing the current event filter.

cases.title: Filter starting date
preconditions: Company-wide history requires a company administrator; exact issue history cases use a currently authorized project reader.
steps: Set a From date.
expected: The service applies the company-calendar lower bound.
notes: Calendar-boundary integration fixtures retain a genuinely emitted owned event but move its timestamp as historical-data setup only in an exact disposable database. One transaction locks the table, captures the exact enabled append-only trigger, restores it before commit, and proves normal updates remain forbidden. No ordinary API timestamp edit is implied.

cases.title: Filter ending date
preconditions: Company-wide history requires a company administrator; exact issue history cases use a currently authorized project reader.
steps: Set a To date.
expected: The company-calendar upper bound applies.
notes: Calendar-boundary integration fixtures retain a genuinely emitted owned event but move its timestamp as historical-data setup only in an exact disposable database. One transaction locks the table, captures the exact enabled append-only trigger, restores it before commit, and proves normal updates remain forbidden. No ordinary API timestamp edit is implied.

cases.title: Reject reversed date range
preconditions: Company-wide history requires a company administrator; exact issue history cases use a currently authorized project reader.
steps: Choose an ending date before the starting date.
expected: Validation rejects the range rather than returning misleading history.

cases.title: Filter exact resource
preconditions: Company-wide history requires a company administrator; exact issue history cases use a currently authorized project reader.
steps: Supply resource kind and valid UUID together.
expected: Only matching resource history is returned.
notes: Calendar-boundary integration fixtures retain a genuinely emitted owned event but move its timestamp as historical-data setup only in an exact disposable database. One transaction locks the table, captures the exact enabled append-only trigger, restores it before commit, and proves normal updates remain forbidden. No ordinary API timestamp edit is implied.

cases.title: Reject resource kind alone
preconditions: Company-wide history requires a company administrator; exact issue history cases use a currently authorized project reader.
steps: Supply kind without identifier.
expected: Validation requires the paired kind and ID.

cases.title: Reject identifier alone
preconditions: Company-wide history requires a company administrator; exact issue history cases use a currently authorized project reader.
steps: Supply resource UUID without kind.
expected: Validation requires the pair.

cases.title: Reject malformed resource identifier
preconditions: Company-wide history requires a company administrator; exact issue history cases use a currently authorized project reader.
steps: Supply an invalid or zero resource UUID.
expected: The filter is rejected before history can be returned.

cases.title: Inspect change details
preconditions: Company-wide history requires a company administrator; exact issue history cases use a currently authorized project reader.
steps: Expand View change details.
expected: Field names and before/after values appear with explicit empty values.

cases.title: Follow issue history link
preconditions: Company-wide history requires a company administrator; exact issue history cases use a currently authorized project reader.
steps: Choose an issue key in an event.
expected: Its issue route opens.

cases.title: Read next history page
preconditions: Company-wide history requires a company administrator; exact issue history cases use a currently authorized project reader.
steps: Choose Next activity page.
expected: A bounded later page in stable descending event order appears.

cases.title: Return to first history page
preconditions: Company-wide history requires a company administrator; exact issue history cases use a currently authorized project reader.
steps: Choose First activity page.
expected: The first page for current filters reloads.

cases.title: Clear history filters
preconditions: Company-wide history requires a company administrator; exact issue history cases use a currently authorized project reader.
steps: Choose Clear history filters.
expected: The filter form resets and current company history reloads.

cases.title: Retry failed history request
preconditions: Company-wide history requires a company administrator; exact issue history cases use a currently authorized project reader.
steps: Use Retry history search after a request failure.
expected: The current intended filters are retried with visible feedback.

cases.title: Show history empty state
preconditions: Company-wide history requires a company administrator; exact issue history cases use a currently authorized project reader.
steps: Use valid filters with no events.
expected: The page explains no activity matches those filters.

cases.title: Deny global activity to ordinary project reader
preconditions: Company-wide history requires a company administrator; exact issue history cases use a currently authorized project reader.
steps: Request unscoped company history without company administrator access.
expected: The service denies the request.

cases.title: Read exact issue history as project reader
preconditions: Company-wide history requires a company administrator; exact issue history cases use a currently authorized project reader.
steps: Request issue resourceKind and exact current accessible issue resourceId.
expected: Relevant retained issue and related-change history is readable.

cases.title: Deny inaccessible issue history
preconditions: Company-wide history requires a company administrator; exact issue history cases use a currently authorized project reader.
steps: Request exact history for an inaccessible or missing issue.
expected: The unavailable outcome does not reveal unrelated activity.

cases.title: Reject mismatched issue project
preconditions: Company-wide history requires a company administrator; exact issue history cases use a currently authorized project reader.
steps: Supply an exact issue resource plus a different project filter.
expected: The issue is unavailable rather than returning cross-project history.

cases.title: Keep personal notification content out of issue history
preconditions: Company-wide history requires a company administrator; exact issue history cases use a currently authorized project reader.
steps: Change a personal inbox read state, then read exact issue history as a different authorized project user and inspect generic company notification audit as company administrator.
expected: Notification read-state events are excluded from exact issue history, including the linked issue. Company administrators may inspect generic read-state audit metadata, but private inbox message bodies are not included in those projections.
notes: The company audit intentionally exposes generic notification read-state changes. Exact issue history explicitly excludes notification resources; this case does not claim administrators cannot see read-state metadata.

cases.title: Preserve retained human attribution
preconditions: Company-wide history requires a company administrator; exact issue history cases use a currently authorized project reader.
steps: Read history after actor disable or project archive.
expected: Retained events remain attributed rather than being deleted with lifecycle changes.

cases.title: Avoid false no-op history
preconditions: Company-wide history requires a company administrator; exact issue history cases use a currently authorized project reader.
steps: Repeat an accepted idempotent mutation or unchanged save.
expected: The business services retain a single change effect rather than duplicate substantive history.

cases.title: Discard stale history result
preconditions: Company-wide history requires a company administrator; exact issue history cases use a currently authorized project reader.
steps: Change filters or account before an older search response arrives.
expected: The current filter/account result cannot be replaced by obsolete data.

cases.title: Render Arabic history values
preconditions: Company-wide history requires a company administrator; exact issue history cases use a currently authorized project reader.
steps: Inspect Arabic actor names, resource names and before/after text.
expected: Bidi isolation and automatic direction preserve readable text.

cases.title: Render change text safely
preconditions: Company-wide history requires a company administrator; exact issue history cases use a currently authorized project reader.
steps: Inspect a change value containing HTML-looking or script-looking text.
expected: The text is displayed as data rather than executed as markup.
